project.name: @desk/web
project.productType: fintech web app: an agent that keeps a Stock Token basket on Robinhood Chain

must: Use the shadcn-named tokens from bridge.css (bg-card, text-muted-foreground, border-border, primary) so 21st components inherit the Masayume look
Numbers in IBM Plex Mono (var(--fm)); money always with its unit
Token logos via TokenLogo (Stock Tokens as discs; USDG/ETH/USDC/USDT/BNB/WETH/DAI from public/logos/tokens), chain logos via ChainLogo (public/logos/chains)
Work at 390px with no horizontal scroll
Plain words: no finance jargon in labels
Money screens use the two-panel money ticket (components/kit/ticket.tsx + features/money/MoveFlow.tsx): ticket left, live summary and action right; never a narrow centred column
Receive is a sheet (features/money/ReceiveSheet.tsx), never a page
avoid: new fonts or a second accent colour
lightweight-charts for new desk charts (TradingView logo)

decisions.decision: UX overhaul per docs/UX-PLAN.md; 21st components picked: 29532 portfolio chart, 20086 donut, 28340 timeline, 10156 radio cards, 29518 stepper, 28355 avatar stack, 28181 number flow, 23552 segmented control, 9659 slider bar, 20110/8034 holdings, 5214 hero, 28170 connections
